name: travel-companion
description: Maintain isolated trip itineraries, reservations, tasks, provisions, map links and source-dated flight observations and weather insights. Queue guarded reminders and bounded proactive reviews for a bound WhatsApp resource or the owning Telegram chat; never books or pays.

POLL_SECONDS.prompt: Polling interval in seconds, at least 60.

REVIEW_INTERVAL_HOURS.prompt: Minimum hours between proactive reviews, at least 1.

REVIEW_HORIZON_DAYS.prompt: Days before travel during which proactive review may run.

MAX_REMINDER_LATENESS_MINUTES.prompt: Maximum reminder lateness before marking it expired instead of sending.
